info.name: Google Calendar AK Today Background Color
info.description: Google Calendar AK Today Background Color - highlight the right hand side of the day in one day view in google calendar
info.additionalInfo:
Please don't judge too harshly, this is my first style and I know it's quite poor, but it does what I want and thought I might share. If you know how to highlight the current day in a 2 day or 3 day view, please let me know. Thanks

This is mostly to stop me accidentally creating a calendar entry on another day when I want to do it for today.
